#  Skills Management Software for the Frontline Workforce
Kahuna is the frontline workforce readiness platform, built on skills and competency management software that validates competency, not just completion. With skills and competency, certification, and career development all connected in one platform, Kahuna helps you assess, validate, and develop your frontline workforce, so you’ll **always know who’s ready now and who’s ready next** for safer, more efficient operations.

## Introducing Kahuna Skills Aggregator
Every plant, hospital, and rig already validates its own skills, just in different words. Skills Aggregator translates that validated data into one enterprise capability language, so workforce planning, deployment, development, and compensation can all run on evidence instead of guesswork, without asking your frontline for anything new.
[**Explore Skills Aggregator →**](https://kahunaworkforce.com/kahuna-skills-aggregator/)

## Make Skills Visibility Your Competitive Advantage
###  Accessible & Actionable Skills Data
### Build a Skills-Based Organization
Kahuna brings human resources, learning, and operations together with validated skills and competency data at the center. As your business scales and evolves, Kahuna helps you streamline operations, make strategic talent decisions, and build a competitive, skills-based organization that is ready for the work in front of you now and all of the work ahead.
[**Gain Real-Time Skills Visibility →**](https://kahunaworkforce.com/digital-skills-checklists/)
![ACCESSIBLE AND ACTION SKILLS DATA - v4](https://kahunaworkforce.com/)
![SKILLS MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE](https://kahunaworkforce.com/)
#### Transparent Skills Insights
### Empower People and the Business
From the frontline worker to the C-suite, Kahuna gives you real-time visibility into workforce readiness. Validated skills and competency insights guide professional development, close skills gaps, inform staffing and deployment, and drive operational decisions, so the right person is ready for the right work at the right time. When growth is the goal, transparent career progression provides a structured path that strengthens engagement and retention.
[**Engage, Retain, and Measure Capability →**](https://kahunaworkforce.com/skills-based-career-development/)
#### Integrated into the Flow of Work
### Make Your Existing Systems Skill-Aware
Say goodbye to siloed systems, spreadsheets, and manual workflows. Kahuna’s API-first platform connects your existing HR, L&D, and operations systems, making them skill-aware and turning scattered workforce data into one real-time view of who is qualified and ready. Certifications and credentials stay current and connected to the roles that require them, so your frontline workforce is always survey- and audit-ready.
[**Improve Compliance and Readiness →**](https://kahunaworkforce.com/audit-ready-skill-records/)
![SKILLS MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE - INTEGRATED IN THE FLOW OF WORK](https://kahunaworkforce.com/)

## One Platform for Workforce and Operational Readiness
Every product in the Kahuna suite runs on the same validated skills data, so nothing lives in a silo and nothing has to be reconciled by hand. From day-to-day readiness on the floor to long-term workforce strategy, each piece works together to keep your people and your operations ready for what’s next.
Skills Management
### Skills Manager
![Kahuna Team Matrix - Skills and Competency Management](https://kahunaworkforce.com/)
Stop guessing who is actually qualified and ready. Kahuna’s flagship product, Skills Manager, helps you capture, assign, assess, and validate your frontline workforce skills, replacing spreadsheets, siloed system data, and guessing games with one system you can trust.
[**Explore Skills Manager →**](https://kahunaworkforce.com/kahuna-skills-manager/)
Professional Development
### Ladder
Give every employee a clear path forward. Ladder turns career advancement into a transparent, structured route that strengthens engagement and retention.
**[Explore Ladder →](https://kahunaworkforce.com/kahuna-ladder/)**
Certification Management
### CertIQ
Stop chasing down certifications. CertIQ tracks credentials automatically, flags lapses before they happen, and makes audit-and survey-prep a checkpoint instead of a crisis.
**[Explore CertIQ →](https://kahunaworkforce.com/kahuna-certiq/)**
Workforce Analytics
### Insights
Turn complex workforce data into actionable business intelligence. Insights surfaces readiness, compliance, and skill gaps as they happen, so leadership can act now in the flow of work.
**[Explore Insights →](https://kahunaworkforce.com/kahuna-insights/)**
Capability Intelligence
### Skills Aggregator
Close the gap between what your frontline workers can do and what your enterprise systems know. Skills Aggregator gives you one clear view of workforce capability to guide staffing, planning, and investments.
**[Explore Skills Aggregator →](https://kahunaworkforce.com/kahuna-skills-aggregator/)**

Improve your workflows, enhance your reporting, and eliminate the manual data entry that pulls your teams away from higher-value work.
